description: Defines a circular map data structure with fixed or dynamic storage, including traits for rebind and specializations for array and vector storage, along with iterators and utility functions.

classes.name: circular_map_impl
classes.description: A circular map container supporting fixed or dynamic storage with optional elements, iteration, and key-based access.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Checks if a key exists in the map.

methods.name: emplace
methods.description: Constructs and inserts an element in-place if no collision occurs.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Inserts an element with a specific key, if no collision occurs.

methods.name: overwrite
methods.description: Inserts or overwrites an element with the given key.

methods.name: erase
methods.description: Removes an element by key or iterator.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Removes all elements from the map.

methods.name: operator[]
methods.description: Accesses the value associated with a key.

methods.name: empty
methods.description: Checks if the map is empty.

methods.name: full
methods.description: Checks if the map has reached maximum capacity.

methods.name: has_space
methods.description: Checks if there is space for a key.
